requirements.title: The Sample Tube Identification Software shall perform a controlled shutdown of the software and OS when requested over the external interface.
The system shall operate in the following states:
State/tPurpose/t/nPowerd On/tOperator powers up the device./nThe operating system starts up and launches the instrument control software./t/nNotInitializedReady to ini
The user shall be able to request SMM system initialization from the IL software.
The user shall be able to identify that the system was successfully initialized.
The SMM system shall complete initialization when all SMM modules could be successfully initialized and all racks, excepting the ones occupied in the pipettor l
If a Fatal Error is generated the system shall suspend all SMM running rack processing jobs.
If a Fatal Error is generated a user interaction is required for recovery (see 2389460).
After a fatal error and possible user recovery an initialization must be performed.
After a Fatal Error the system shall abort any pending rack processing job during initialization.
The system execution shall stop after reporting a Fatal event and the system status goes to E-Stop (Halted).
SMM shall automatically restart after an unexpected software failure./nSMM shall inform IW about the fact that the SW was not shut down properly./nAfterwards the
SMM shall publish the following changes in system information and configuration so that it can be shown and appropriate action can be taken if needed: /n- SMM sy
The system shall operate in the following states: /n- Powered On: Booting OS and SW/n- Not Initialized: Ready to initialize or configure/n- Initializing: Homing al
appSMM shall publish system status Clearing when racks are moved to the output./nIn case of success appSMM shall publish system status Idle after clearing finish
appSMM shall initiate recovery from fatal error codition (E-Stopped) when requested./nAfter recovery the state will be not initialized (2387196).
appSMM shall automatically publish system status (2384071) changes as they occur.
appSMM shall initiate an immediate shutdown of the software and OS when requested.
appSMM shall publish system status (2384071) when requested.
appSMM shall initiate system initialization when requested./n(Only possible when state is not initialized)
The user shall be able to initiate error recovery from the IL software, after fatal error scenario (see 1932312 and 1932314 for more details).

specifications.text: The SMM:/n- Responsible for association of sample ID to tube position and rack./n- Moves racks efficiently through the system./n- Dynamically routes racks through the system as FIFO, while respecting constraints provided per rack via the Bridge for priorities and destinations./n- Actively requests the route for each rack in the system, at each destination decision checkpoint and state change (based on the current SMM and track state, rack location and/or bridge's reroute notification)./nThe Bridge:/n- The single point of interface for all SMM to analyzer and IW communications./n- Upon request from the SMM, calculates the next destination analyzer for the rack. The algorithm to determine the route is Werfen’s responsibility and is independent of the track logic. The route (next analyzer) is calculated based on the analyzers' capabilities, analyzer's current schedule, analyzer's material expiration, configuration options on the IW and test orders coming from the IW./n- Upon request from the SMM, calculates the next analyzer for the rack. The algorithm to determine the route is Werfen’s responsibility and is independent of the track logic. Currently the route (next analyzer) is calculated based on a multitude of considerations e.g. analyzers' capabilities, analyzers' current schedule, analyzers' material expiration, configuration options, resource utilization and sample test orders./n- Assigns the priority and destination analyzer specific for each requested rack./nThe IW:/n- Assigns test orders to the samples (via LIS or manual entry)./n- Cancels test orders./n- Recalls a sample./n- Manages jobs for each test order./n- Creates Rerun/Reflex jobs when necessary./n- Handles the completion and release for each sample./n- Initiates system operating commands and settings, e.g. change of states, configuration, shutdown, etc./n- Collects and responds to system monitoring and error management information./n- Is a system module external to the SMM, and therefore not in the scope of this requirement document.
